The '''Grand Ballroom''' was the main ballroom aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[orchestra]] played soothing subharmonic [[Music/Legends|music]] to allow passengers to dance.<ref name="RPG" />
